description: OTS v2 (WOTS+ over all 64 normalized symbols) cross-SDK vectors. Spec: docs/OTS_V2_SPECIFICATION.md. Regenerate only via scripts/gen-ots-v2-vectors.mjs; never hand-edit.

tests.name: genuine_v2
tests.notes: v2-signed M molecule with its ContinuID I atom.

tests.name: genuine_v1_control
tests.notes: The same molecule signed with the v1 key at the same position; its signing address differs from the v2 one.

tests.name: window_forgery_v1
tests.notes: CONTROL: the v1 16-symbol window defect; stays verified while v1 is accepted. Forward-hashed from genuine_v1_control without the key.

tests.name: window_forgery_v2
tests.notes: The same attack against genuine_v2: chains with n'_i <= n_i are forward-hashed, the rest left unchanged. Symbol firstViolatingIndex would need a hash preimage.

tests.name: v1_signature_on_v2_wallet
tests.notes: genuine_v2 carrying a v1 signature by the same secret and position over the same hash: no downgrade.

tests.name: truncated_v2
tests.notes: genuine_v2 with the last 4 base64 characters removed: 4,093 bytes is neither length.
